terms.Title: Terms of Use
terms.Summary: By using the CHROMATIK platform you agree to the following terms.

Sections.Title: Parties and Scope
Sections.Body: These terms govern the relationship between the CHROMATIK platform and every user who visits, registers, uploads content or makes a purchase.

Sections.Title: Description of Service
Sections.Body: CHROMATIK is a marketplace where producers publish and license beats and soundkits, and buyers listen to and purchase licenses for that content. The platform acts as an intermediary service provider between seller and buyer.

Sections.Title: Membership and Account Security
Sections.Body: You must provide accurate and up-to-date information to register. You are responsible for the security of your account and password; all actions performed through your account are deemed yours.

Sections.Title: Content Upload Rules
Sections.Body: You declare that you own the rights to, or have obtained the necessary permissions for, all content you upload. Content that infringes copyright, contains uncleared samples or is otherwise unlawful will be removed upon notice.

Sections.Title: Prohibited Use
Sections.Body: You may not use the platform for fraud, spam, automated scraping, unauthorized access to other accounts or any activity that disrupts the operation of the system.

Sections.Title: Intellectual Property
Sections.Body: The CHROMATIK brand, logo and interface design belong to the platform. Rights to user-uploaded content remain with the respective producer and may only be used within the scope of the purchased license.

Sections.Title: Limitation of Liability
Sections.Body: The platform is not a direct party to disputes arising from license relationships between users and cannot be held liable for indirect damages caused by service interruptions or data loss.

Sections.Title: Changes and Governing Law
Sections.Body: These terms may be updated; the current version is always published on this page. Disputes are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye.

privacy.Title: Privacy Policy and KVKK Notice
privacy.Summary: Explains how your personal data is processed under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

Sections.Title: Data Controller
Sections.Body: Your personal data is processed by CHROMATIK, as data controller, for the purposes described in this notice.

Sections.Title: Personal Data Processed
Sections.Body: Name, username, email address, profile image, language preference, purchase and sales history, listening statistics, IP address and browser information may be processed.

Sections.Title: Purposes of Processing
Sections.Body: Creating memberships, running purchase and licensing processes, providing sales statistics to producers, keeping the platform secure and fulfilling legal obligations.

Sections.Title: Legal Grounds
Sections.Body: Your data is processed on the basis of entering into and performing a contract, legal obligations, legitimate interest and, where required, your explicit consent.

Sections.Title: Transfers
Sections.Body: Your data may be shared only as required by the service with payment institutions, hosting providers and authorized public bodies. When a sale is completed, the buyer's username is shared with the relevant producer.

Sections.Title: Retention Period
Sections.Body: Your personal data is kept for as long as the processing purpose requires and for the statutory retention periods, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

Sections.Title: Your Rights
Sections.Body: Under Article 11 of the KVKK you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request its correction or deletion, and object to processing. You can send your requests to the contact address on the support page.

license.Title: License Agreement
license.Summary: Explains the scope and usage rights of beat licenses purchased on the platform.

Sections.Title: General Provisions
Sections.Body: Purchasing a license grants the usage rights specified for the chosen license type, not ownership of the work. Copyright remains with the producer except for Exclusive licenses.

Sections.Title: Basic Lease
Sections.Body: An untagged MP3 file is delivered. Includes non-commercial and limited commercial use, with distribution rights up to a set stream and sales limit. Non-exclusive; the beat may be licensed to others.

Sections.Title: Premium Lease
Sections.Body: High-quality WAV and MP3 files are delivered. Offers higher stream and sales limits than the Basic license. Non-exclusive.

Sections.Title: Unlimited Lease
Sections.Body: WAV, MP3 and track stems are delivered. Provides distribution rights without stream or sales limits. Non-exclusive.

Sections.Title: Exclusive Rights
Sections.Body: Exclusive usage rights to the beat transfer to the buyer and the track is removed from sale. Non-exclusive licenses granted before the exclusive sale remain valid.

Sections.Title: Credit and Attribution
Sections.Body: For every license type, the producer must be credited on every platform where the work is released. Example: Prod. by producer name.

Sections.Title: Prohibited Use
Sections.Body: Reselling the beat on its own, distributing it through another library, or registering it with content identification (Content ID) systems without the producer's permission is prohibited.

cookies.Title: Cookie Policy
cookies.Summary: Provides information about the cookies and similar technologies used on the platform.

Sections.Title: What Are Cookies?
Sections.Body: Cookies and local storage are small pieces of data that a site stores in your browser so that it can remember you.

Sections.Title: Essential Cookies
Sections.Body: Required to keep you signed in, preserve your cart and maintain security. The platform does not work properly without them.

Sections.Title: Preference Cookies
Sections.Body: Used to remember your preferences such as language, volume and player settings.

Sections.Title: Analytics Cookies
Sections.Body: Anonymous usage statistics may be collected to understand how the platform is used and improve performance.

Sections.Title: Managing Cookies
Sections.Body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may cause some features to stop working.

distanceSales.Title: Distance Sales Agreement
distanceSales.Summary: Governs digital product sales under Turkish Consumer Protection Law No. 6502 and the Distance Contracts Regulation.

Sections.Title: Parties
Sections.Body: The seller is the producer who publishes the product on the platform; the buyer is the user who completes the purchase. CHROMATIK is the platform that mediates the sale.

Sections.Title: Subject of the Agreement
Sections.Body: The sale of the digital audio file ordered electronically by the buyer and its associated usage license, together with the rights and obligations of the parties.

Sections.Title: Product and Price Information
Sections.Body: The product name, license type, delivered file formats and total price including taxes are shown to the buyer at checkout.

Sections.Title: Payment and Delivery
Sections.Body: Payment is taken by credit or debit card through a secure payment infrastructure. Once payment is confirmed, the files and license document are delivered to the buyer's account instantly.

Sections.Title: Right of Withdrawal
Sections.Body: Under Article 15 of the Distance Contracts Regulation, there is no right of withdrawal for intangible goods delivered instantly in electronic form. The buyer accepts this by confirming the purchase.

Sections.Title: Dispute Resolution
Sections.Body: Consumer Arbitration Committees and Consumer Courts have jurisdiction within the monetary limits announced by the Ministry of Trade.

refund.Title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.Summary: Explains when refunds can be issued for digital products.

Sections.Title: General Rule
Sections.Body: Because purchased products are digital content delivered instantly, no refunds are issued for withdrawal or change of mind once the download has taken place.

Sections.Title: Eligible Cases
Sections.Body: A refund may be requested if the delivered file is corrupted or does not match its description, if the same product was accidentally purchased more than once, or if payment was taken but delivery did not occur.

Sections.Title: Request Process
Sections.Body: Send your refund request with your order details to the contact address on the support page within 14 days of the purchase date.

Sections.Title: Resolution
Sections.Body: Approved requests are refunded to the original payment method within 14 days at the latest. The related license becomes void after the refund.

Sections.Title: Exclusive Sales
Sections.Body: Since the track is removed from the catalog after an exclusive sale, refunds are only possible if delivery failed due to a technical error.

Support.Title: How can we help you?
Support.Subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions here, and write to us directly about anything else.

Faq.Q: How do I buy a beat?
Faq.A: Choose a license type on the track page or card, add it to your cart and proceed to checkout. Once payment is confirmed, the files are delivered to your account instantly.

Faq.Q: What is the difference between license types?
Faq.A: Basic includes MP3, Premium includes WAV and MP3, and Unlimited includes track stems with unlimited distribution rights. With an Exclusive license the track becomes yours alone and is removed from sale. See the License Agreement for details.

Faq.Q: Where can I download my purchases?
Faq.A: After checkout, your files and license document are available in the purchases section of your account and can be re-downloaded at any time.

Faq.Q: How can I sell as a producer?
Faq.A: Create a free account, upload your track from the Studio Panel, set prices for each license type and publish. You can follow your sales statistics from the same panel.
All payments are processed through a secure payment infrastructure encrypted with 256-bit SSL. Your card details are never stored on CHROMATIK servers.

Digital products are delivered instantly, so refunds are generally not issued. However, refunds are possible for corrupted files, duplicate purchases or undelivered orders. See the Refund & Cancellation Policy for details.
